dialogues.jp: 「うーむ……」

卒パのパンフを眺めながら、廊下の隅で｛うな／唸｝る。
せっかくの祭りだと言うのに、俺の隣には女子
はおろか｛ヤロー／男の子｝すらいない。
dialogues.en:
I grunted as I looked through the graduation party's
brochure. It's supposed to be a festival but unfortunately,
there were no girls or even any guys standing next to me.
dialogues.text:
I grunted as I looked through the graduation party's
brochure. It's supposed to be a festival but unfortunately,
there were no girls or even any guys standing next to me.

dialogues.jp:
かったるかったが、それなりに感動的だった卒
業式も終わり、今は卒業パーティーが始まって
いた。
dialogues.en:
The troublesome, but impressive graduation ceremony was
over, and the graduation party had started.
dialogues.text:
The troublesome, but impressive graduation ceremony was
over, and the graduation party had started.

dialogues.jp:
学園内は、午前中とは打って変わった熱気に包
まれている。
dialogues.en:
The school had a completely different atmosphere compared to
this morning.
dialogues.text:
The school had a completely different atmosphere compared to
this morning.

dialogues.jp: 「どっからどう見ても学園祭だよな」
dialogues.en: "This looks just like a school festival."
dialogues.text: "This looks just like a school festival."

dialogues.jp:
呼子の声が響き渡る廊下を歩きながら、独りで
感想を漏らす。
dialogues.en:
I muttered as I walked through the crowded and extremely
noisy hallways.
dialogues.text:
I muttered as I walked through the crowded and extremely
noisy hallways.

dialogues.jp:
音夢と美春は風紀委員の仕事で学園内を巡回し
ているはずだし、杉並は今ごろ、計画発動の最
終段階に入っているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and Miharu are patrolling around the school as part of
the safety committee, and Suginami's probably working on his
final preparations for whatever he has planned for today.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and Miharu are patrolling around the school as part of
the safety committee, and Suginami's probably working on his
final preparations for whatever he has planned for today.

dialogues.jp: 今日のあいつには正直近づかんほうがいい。
dialogues.en: To be honest, I don't want to be around him today.
dialogues.text: To be honest, I don't want to be around him today.

dialogues.jp: （いや、いつもか……）
dialogues.en: (Actually, not just today but every day......)
dialogues.text: (Actually, not just today but every day......)

dialogues.jp:
ちなみに、さくらは卒業式終了と同時に周囲を
取り囲まれ、まず脱出の見込みはない。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was surrounded by people after the graduation, and
there's no way she can get out of that.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was surrounded by people after the graduation, and
there's no way she can get out of that.

dialogues.jp: 「暇だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm bored."
dialogues.text: "I'm bored."

dialogues.jp: ひとりでまわっても、全然盛り上がらない。
dialogues.en: It's not very entertaining to walk around all by myself.
dialogues.text: It's not very entertaining to walk around all by myself.

dialogues.jp: （虚しい……）
dialogues.en: (I feel pathetic......)
dialogues.text: (I feel pathetic......)

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、これだけ数があって、俺を楽しまさ
せられないなんて、どういうことだ？
dialogues.en:
There are so many different activities, but why can't I
enjoy any of them?
dialogues.text:
There are so many different activities, but why can't I
enjoy any of them?

dialogues.jp:
手元のパンフレットには、校舎内にギッシリ、
校舎外にゴッチャリと店名が書かれている。
dialogues.en:
I see so many different events and store names on the
brochure.
dialogues.text:
I see so many different events and store names on the
brochure.

dialogues.jp:
なまじ個人単位で参加が自由なだけに、出店数
は普通の文化祭の２．５倍（当社比）。
dialogues.en:
There's about 2.5 times more stores compared to the school
festival.
dialogues.text:
There's about 2.5 times more stores compared to the school
festival.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、いい……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Oh well...... hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Oh well...... hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
『占いの館』とプリントされた文字が、目にと
まる。場所は第２音楽室……。
dialogues.en:
I saw a page that said 'Fortune telling' in the brochure.
It's in the second music room......
dialogues.text:
I saw a page that said 'Fortune telling' in the brochure.
It's in the second music room......

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩のところか……」
dialogues.en: "That's Moe-sempai's place......"
dialogues.text: "That's Moe-sempai's place......"

dialogues.jp: そう言えば、結局占いって何をするんだろう？
dialogues.en: I wonder what kind of fortune-telling she's doing......
dialogues.text: I wonder what kind of fortune-telling she's doing......

dialogues.jp:
「オーソドックスなところではタロット占いと
　か占星術あたりか」
dialogues.en:
"She might be doing an old-fashioned fortune-telling like
Tarot reading or horoscopes......"
dialogues.text:
"She might be doing an old-fashioned fortune-telling like
Tarot reading or horoscopes......"

dialogues.jp: 水晶占いなんかもあるかもしれないな。
dialogues.en: She might even have a crystal ball reading.
dialogues.text: She might even have a crystal ball reading.

dialogues.jp: あとはなんだろう……。
dialogues.en: What else......?
dialogues.text: What else......?

dialogues.jp: 「――おみくじ？」
dialogues.en: "......Perhaps a fortune slip?"
dialogues.text: "......Perhaps a fortune slip?"

dialogues.jp:
「ま、なんでもいいや。とりあえず萌先輩の様
　子でも見に行ってみるかな」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'll go check out what Moe-sempai's doing."
dialogues.text: "I guess I'll go check out what Moe-sempai's doing."

dialogues.jp: 階段に足をかけ、１段１段上っていく。
dialogues.en: I took the stairs one by one.
dialogues.text: I took the stairs one by one.

dialogues.jp: ◆いざ、占いの館へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Going to the fortune telling◆
dialogues.text: ◆Going to the fortune telling◆

dialogues.jp: 一人で回ってもさすがにつまらない。
dialogues.en: It's boring to walk around on my own.
dialogues.text: It's boring to walk around on my own.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、萌先輩の占いへと行く事にした。
dialogues.en: I decided to go see Moe-sempai at the fortune telling.
dialogues.text: I decided to go see Moe-sempai at the fortune telling.
